design: Read all 192 geometrical cell centers on SHASSA tile 153, not a selection based on M8/M20 broadband values. Use identical projected circular apertures at both radii and reproduce the six pinned prior cells. At each radius compare original, lowest six medians via deterministic cell-ID tie breaks, and lowest eligible median per six fixed spatial strata (two row groups and three column groups). For equal independent unit-variance anchor errors fit a plane to normalized coordinates and evaluate prediction standard deviation across all 192 centers, including leave-one-anchor sensitivity. Report descriptive H-alpha values only. Cells reuse one survey tile, their apertures can overlap, and no uncertainty covariance or ADU conversion is inferred.
